newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Fogade to roll over $276 million bond.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Fogade to roll over $276 million bond.

text.p: Venezuelan bank deposits guarantee fund Fogade will roll over a 130 billion bolivar ($276 million) bond that comes due on September 21 with a new six-month issue, Fogade said.
The roll over comes after the recent failed privatisation of Banco de Venezuela left Fogade without sufficient funds, Fogade said in a press release.

Fifteen percent, or 19.5 billion bolivars, of the principal due on the Series A bond that was issued in December 1995 will be paid off. But the remainder will be rolled over into a new issue that will carry a coupon equivalent to commercial bank deposit rates, plus eight percentage points.
Fogade also said it would pay 25.2 billion bolivars ($53 million) of interest due on the 300 billion bolivar total of all bonds issued by Fogade in December 1995.

The bonds were used to back 367 billion bolivars in deposits transferred to state-owned banks Latino, Consolidado, Venezuela and Republica from banks that failed during Venezuela's 1994-5 financial crisis.
The crisis consumed some 10 percent of GDP in state bail- outs.
